Synopsis:
The U.S. DOE, alongside DOI, Commerce, and Transportation, is pursuing the Floating Offshore Wind (FOW) Shot — a multi-agency initiative targeting a >70% cost reduction in floating offshore wind energy to $45/MWh by 2035. Floating wind is critical for deep-water sites representing ~2/3 of U.S. offshore wind potential. The programme requires domestic supply chain build-out, technology cost reduction, and transmission infrastructure. Progress milestones and summits (2023, 2024) are tracking delivery.
